judged.play: Pre-match agent selection screen while the creator holds up a Phoenix action figure.
judged.line: I want a Phoenix ace tonight, Asuna.
judged.reason: Pre-match filler holding a figurine without any actual gameplay.

judged.play: LEV player switches off Phoenix during agent pick screen.
judged.line: He knows he's no match for Asuna!
judged.reason: Mild banter during agent pick screen before match starts.

judged.play: Early round setup on site with confusing positioning.
judged.line: I don't know what I've just seen in the past 15 seconds.
judged.reason: Low-action setup round with minimal payoff on screen.

judged.play: Round ends rapidly as LEV players fall in quick succession.
judged.line: Why did that happen so fast?
judged.reason: Amusing quick round win, but lacks a clear highlight play on camera.

judged.play: 100T sets up mid-round while creator predicts a blowout score.
judged.reason: Routine prediction during quiet mid-round gameplay.

judged.play: LEV calls a timeout and their coach dramatically slams the huge illuminated timeout button on stage.
judged.line: That is so dramatic for no reason! Look at it shining!
judged.reason: Hilarious stage observation reacting to the oversized timeout button.

judged.play: Duplicate broadcast clip showing LEV timeout button press.
judged.line: That is so dramatic for no reason!
judged.reason: Duplicate candidate clip of the timeout button moment already covered in c06.

judged.play: 100T executes onto site under Harbor cove and plants spike.
judged.reason: Standard site execute without major duel highlights.

judged.play: Bang locks down the site with clean kills to secure the round.
judged.reason: Solid round win with creator's usual catchphrase, but standard for this watch party.

judged.play: LEV delivers a devastating flawless round wiping out 100T instantly.
judged.reason: Unfiltered shock with hands on head reacting to an overwhelming flawless round.

judged.play: 100T aggressively takes map control and closes out another round win.
judged.reason: Good team round win cheer, but lacks an extraordinary individual outplay.

judged.play: 100T shuts down LEV push with multi-kills and clean aim.
judged.reason: High-energy reaction shouting and clutching head after a dominant round shut-down.

judged.play: 100T sets up retake utility near A site.
judged.reason: Brief setup clip with limited action before the action unfolds.

judged.play: Round replay reveals a player firing an entire magazine into a wall in panic.
judged.line: He was out here emptying that clip against that wall!
judged.reason: Genuinely funny spectator moment catching a severe whiff on replay.

judged.play: Replay review of Yoru flash mechanics while creator comments on patch balance.
judged.line: Glory to God, because that was super broken!
judged.reason: Analytic stream discussion about game balancing rather than a hype play.

judged.play: LEV secures a tense round win despite 100T's defense effort.
judged.reason: Expressive reaction to a round loss, but less dramatic than c10 or c19.

judged.play: Creator reviews scoreboards and discusses player agent choices between rounds.
judged.reason: Downtime commentary and player stats review.

judged.play: LEV continues a 4-round winning streak to bring the score close.
judged.line: What the freak? It was looking dominant for 100 Thieves!
judged.reason: Good dramatic tension as LEV mounts a comeback, but secondary to c19.

judged.play: LEV completes a 5-round streak comeback to close the half, player cam shows hyped reactions.
judged.line: Oh my goodness! These guys woke up, what the heck!
judged.reason: Great vocal disbelief and head-grabbing reaction as the opposing team completes a huge half comeback.
